method: Cumberland DCP Part B is FIVE sub-Parts in one 54-page PDF. Each opens with a full divider page ('PART B1 DWELLING HOUSES AND SECONDARY DWELLINGS' at 36pt, PyMuPDF spans) followed by a 'left intentionally blank' page, then its own '1. Introduction / 1.1 Land to which this Part applies'. A sub-Part owns the pages strictly between its divider page and the next sub-Part's divider page. Divider pages themselves, and the cover/contents pages 1-5 before B1's divider, are NOT resolved. Page numbers are 1-based PDF pages (= regulatory_provisions.pdf_page); the PDF's own footer 'Page B8 of B54' agrees.
